decisionGates.description: Confirm whether Spec 006 must produce audible realtime desktop playback, offline rendered audio, or a deterministic command-plan simulator first.
Stop after generating first transition artifacts and ask the user to audition them before expanding strategy behavior.

subagentExecutionRules: Before executing any task, read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all requiredSteeringContext files.
Treat current-autodj-signal BPM/beatgrid as fixed input. Prefer Rekordbox XML semantic labels when available; treat dubstep-phrase-hybrid as an experimental/fallback semantic provider.
Do not re-open MIR candidate selection or section-threshold tuning unless a task explicitly says to do so.
Keep real audio, rendered mixes, local analysis artifacts, and generated audition files out of git.
Prefer deterministic plan generation and testable scheduling before adding complex UI behavior.
Every generated transition must include debug annotations describing chosen sections, measure counts, cue points, and fallback reasons.
Stop at manual audition checkpoints and record the user's listening verdict before marking the checkpoint complete.
Update tasks.md checkboxes only after completing and verifying the specific task.
